Name: Pregnancy and Birth Events
Author: kristinthered
Description:
[size=3]If you like my mod, please consider [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/kristinthered]buying me a coffee! [/url][/size][b][size=3]
[/size][/b]
[size=5]Mod Overview:[/size]
[size=3]The pregnancy (or first adoption) event will trigger the day after you choose to have a baby with your spouse. (You must enter your farmhouse to see the pregnancy event—I have not coded any events to take place at the Ginger Island farmhouse or any modded locations.)[/size]
[size=3]The birth (or 2nd adoption) event will trigger 13 days after the pregnancy event. (You will need to choose a name for your baby prior to seeing the birth or adoption event.)[/size]

[size=4][b]This mod includes: [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Events where the bachelors of Pelican Town react to the news that you are pregnant. [/size]
[*][size=3]Events where the bachelorettes of Pelican Town react to the news that they are pregnant. [/size]
[*][size=3]An event where you and your spouse fill out your adoption paperwork. [/size]
[*][size=3]An event where your baby is dropped off by the adoption agency.[/size]
[/list]

[size=4][u]Content that I want to add, but will take some time: 
[/u][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Male pregnancies.[/size]
[*][size=3]Pregnancy and child-related dialogue.[/size]
[*][size=3]More adoption events.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unique birth and pregnancy events for custom NPCs, if I can get permission from their respective modders. [/size]
[*][size=3]Pregnancy check-up events at the clinic.[/size]
[/list][b]
[size=5][u]Important Notes: 
[/u][/size][/b][size=3]This mod is [b][u]NOT[/u] [/b]currently compatible with kdau's Pregnancy role or PolyamorySweet. [b]I am currently working on another version of this mod that will fix this![/b]

This mod will add [b][u]GENERIC [/u][/b]birth and pregnancy events for custom characters, including marriage candidates in Stardew Valley Expanded, East Scarp, Ridgeside Village, etc. 

[b]If you add this mod to a save where the farmer or their spouse is already pregnant, weird things may occur. Download at your own risk. [/b][/size][b]
[/b]
[size=3]Things are still pretty buggy in multiplayer—if you have an issue, please DM me your [url=https://smapi.io/log]parsed SMAPI log[/url]. 

[size=5][u]2.0.15+ Update Notes: 
[/u][/size]
*I removed the pregnancy dialogue from this update.*
I will add it back in a future update! (I just have a lot to write for it, and I really wanted to get this update out there.) 

I added GENERIC events for the farmer's first and second pregnancy and birth events. 
[size=3]This means that you can see these events even if you are married to a custom NPC!
[/size]I want to add similar generic events for spouse pregnancy and birth events (including male pregnancies and births) in a future update. My goal is to still have unique pregnancy and birth events for at least all of the vanilla marriage candidates. I'll fill those in in future updates as well. 

And I converted all of the event dialogue to i18n... but that's not as fun to talk about. 
[/size]

[/b]Hospital bed overlay in the birth event: [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/123730183-cptnmatruz/]cptnmatruz
[/url]Coding changes for an easy visual update to accommodate for 1.6 changes: [b]MsChapstick[/b]
Spanish translation: [b]Iolanthe22[/b]
Literally everything else: the Stardew Valley modding community on Discord[/size]
